articles.summary: HOUSTON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 13, 2025-- DNOW Inc. (NYSE: DNOW ) (“DNOW” or “the Company”) today announced its future leadership team effective upon the completion of the pending transaction with MRC Global Inc. (NYSE: MRC) (“MRC Global”). The team will be comprised of leaders from both companies
articles.title: DNOW Announces Future Leadership Team for Combined Company
